acceptanceCriteria: Configured-cleanup/no-health true-native fixture: fresh eligible upgraded direct pooled claim has a writer-produced origin witness; explicit OWNER/OPERATOR release --lane-untouched --evidence Identifier atomically ends and fences the generation, releases ordinary reservations, retains full terminal attestation and original allocation, and frees only that exact occupancy without running configured cleanup. A successor claim receives a new allocation. This is local operator attestation, not observed physical non-use or authenticated independent identity.

No-flag release/handoff, expiry, reap and completion preserve existing quarantine/cleanup/confirm-safe behavior and fixed historical absent-feature request/attempt/result bytes. Null command metadata alone never authorizes reuse. Prospective witness is absent for legacy, prepared/health, and retry-inherited history; renewed leases are ineligible. Old readers may refuse new witness/attestation metadata; retain that compatibility/rollback limit.

Fresh opt-in requires current live external-agent RUNNING generation, exact origin/tuple/pool/member-definition/holder/stage/sequence bindings, unchanged acceptance/policy, ALLOCATED no-health direct origin, and no candidate, gate/reviews/manifest/failed-or-unknown retry accounting/pending effects/runner/spawn/worker/supervision/lane identity. Known or uncertain use, malformed/missing origin/history, expired/renewed/changed tuples or wrong actor role refuse without freeing. Native programs bytes must match the same inventory/head; matching ADMITTED before ATTACH with zero PID, SPAWNING/RUNNING and ambiguous associations refuse. Private Dispatcher and external physical facts remain outside automatic qualification.

Canonical opt-in request binds flag/evidence/fixed profile acknowledgements conditionally, preserving legacy absent bytes and static shape-before-replay/current-eligibility-after-replay ordering. Fresh and replay responses reconstruct the full original allocation and attestation from the original RELEASE receipt inline or bounded payload after digest/actor/profile/evidence/tuple verification; successor/policy changes never substitute current state. Actually changed named request fields conflict. Missing/damaged payload refuses. Crash/redo/archive round-trip preserve all-or-nothing terminal attestation, generation fencing, reservation removal and exact occupancy removal.

Retain the four fixed explicit operator acknowledgements, inert evidence Identifier and physicalFacts NOT_OBSERVED boundary in CLI/spec/report; amend CAL030/032/044/046 only for this named optional profile. Preserve declared resources, requiresPool, default quarantine, allocation correspondence and retry accounting; no implicit exemption, broker, private-dispatch scan or cleanup execution on replay.

Qualify with focused transaction/snapshot/store/CLI tests and vet, actual configured-cleanup positive true-native fixture plus negative/preATTACH/legacy/renewal/replay/archive/crash evidence, one independent implementation/acceptance review, owning stable CAL intent and CEM/OCM frozen checks with truthful limits, ready PR/CI/approved integration and actual native submit/gate/complete/readback/receipt audit. Issue479 remains OPEN until these pass; issue480 completion does not discharge it.

Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/479
Original public baseline: 6c9116d5a63158fd2e30040138c9a8ff5f5ebac7 (2026-10-02).
Observed tools: Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163; Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202. Official release tags observed v1.0.0-rc.1 and tasks-dev-20260929.2; not broad runtime qualification.
Issue reports that review/integrate no-op claims consumed demo-lanes members and release/handoff quarantined them, forcing reset/health/confirm-safe. Expected requested behavior: avoid consuming/resetting an unused lane. Actual source: internal/tasks/transaction/pools.go poolPosts unconditionally quarantines terminal allocations, matching accepted CAL-V0-030 and CAL-V0-046. commandKind is health/cleanup metadata, not external lane-command history; null does not prove untouched status or revoked external access.
Existing capabilities: read-only plan preview --pool --stage and ticket blockers; claim eligibility/scope/capacity/retry checks precede admission; no --pool consumes no member when ticket has no requiresPool. Preserve native queue authority and all declared resources. This is a capability/safety-contract request, not a confirmed existing-contract violation.
Private Gate A proposal: /private/tmp/corvint-479-readonly-plan.md. Root has released native writes but prohibits claim/implementation until safety review and slot; source work only in clean origin/main leaf. Precise accepted scope remains to be reviewed. No tests or implementation claimed.

Operator-attested profile proposed for next admitted intent phase. Owner-authored issue479 explicitly accepts an attestation alternative; bounded R1 Gate A PASS at proposal SHA23269d211a3c2b1b4acef38cb08aa0392634d35ba3b141abb840f29242207198. Authority and exact eligibility/replay/compatibility/qualification/rollback are retained in /private/tmp/corvint-479-attested-profile-gatea.md. This replaces the earlier preflight-only implementation route with the reviewed explicit OWNER/OPERATOR release --lane-untouched --evidence Identifier profile. Existing default quarantine is accepted behavior; no null-command proof is inferred. Native intent refinement, stable requirement assignment and full future effects remain pending root serial admission.

INIT admitted by root at public main094700bfbc7b637bd2d6405cd82ab5508ac4aa20, prospective CAL-V0-067/S17 assigned. Refine route now to the accepted operator-attested profile; fullfuture26PATH22nonPATH effects remain INCOMPLETE. Keep strict current policy/config identity for flagged release, exclude it from issue482 HandoffPolicyCandidate fallback, preserve ordinary compatible handoff and quarantine. No implementation or qualification claimed. Existing authority/GateA plus root094 delta review retained; source review follows implementation. Primary hold remains; isolated leaf only.
